name: Suspicious Use of PsLogList
description: Detects usage of the PsLogList utility to dump event log in order to extract admin accounts and perform account discovery or delete events logs
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Another tool that uses the command line switches of PsLogList
Legitimate use of PsLogList by an administrator
query: (process.pe.original_file_name:psloglist.exe OR (process.executable:(*\\psloglist.exe OR *\\psloglist64.exe))) AND (process.command_line:(*\ security* OR *\ application* OR *\ system*)) AND (process.command_line:(*\ \-d* OR *\ \/d* OR *\ –d* OR *\ —d* OR *\ ―d*) OR process.command_line:(*\ \-x* OR *\ \/x* OR *\ –x* OR *\ —x* OR *\ ―x*) OR process.command_line:(*\ \-s* OR *\ \/s* OR *\ –s* OR *\ —s* OR *\ ―s*) OR process.command_line:(*\ \-c* OR *\ \/c* OR *\ –c* OR *\ —c* OR *\ ―c*) OR process.command_line:(*\ \-g* OR *\ \/g* OR *\ –g* OR *\ —g* OR *\ ―g*))
